original_value: In the context of Industry 4.0, lot of effort is being put to achieve interoperability among industrial applications. As the definition and adoption of communication standards are of paramount importance for the realization of interoperability, during the last few years different organizations have developed reference architectures to align standards in the context of the fourth industrial revolution. One of the main examples is the reference architecture model for Industry 4.0, which defines the asset administration shell as the corner stone of the interoperability between applications managing manufacturing systems. Inside Industry 4.0 there is also so much interest behind the standard open platform communications unified architecture (OPC UA), which is listed as the one recommendation for realizing the communication layer of the reference architecture model. The contribution of this paper is to give some insights behind modelling techniques that should be adopted during the definition of OPC UA Information Model exposing information of the very recent metamodel defined for the asset administration shell. All the general rationales and solutions here provided are compared with the current OPC UA-based existing representation of asset administration shell provided by literature. Specifically, differences will be pointed out giving to the reader advantages and disadvantages behind each solution.

result.paraphrase: Within Industry 4.0, considerable effort is being devoted to achieving interoperability among industrial applications. Since communication standards are crucial for interoperability, several organizations have, over the past few years, developed reference architectures to align standards for the fourth industrial revolution. A key example is the Reference Architecture Model for Industry 4.0, which identifies the asset administration shell as the cornerstone of interoperability between applications that manage manufacturing systems. Industry 4.0 also places strong emphasis on the standard Open Platform Communications Unified Architecture (OPC UA), which is the only recommended option for implementing the communication layer of the reference architecture model. This paper offers insights into the modeling techniques that should be used when defining an OPC UA information model to expose information from the very recent metamodel defined for the asset administration shell. The general rationales and solutions presented here are compared with the current OPC UA-based representations of the asset administration shell found in the literature. In particular, the differences are highlighted so that readers can weigh the advantages and disadvantages of each approach.
